title: Adaptive music is six synced stems crossfaded per state on bar lines
intent: Music follows the fight without abrupt cuts, using layered stems rather than switching tracks

attempts.approach: fade stems before the browser unlocked audio
attempts.failureReason: play() reset every volume, so music started silent after a long wait; now nothing fades before start and start re-applies gains

attempts.approach: hold every downward change four bars
attempts.failureReason: the end of a run waited 8 s to settle; run-over now counts as an event

evidence.description: changes land on bar lines, no flip-flop under 1 s enemy churn, no fade step above 1% per frame, stems start in sync

constraints.statement: All six stems start together and never stop or seek during a run; state changes only change gains
MusicDirector decides only on bar lines; rising holds 1 bar, falling 4, and giant, blackout, leaving blackout and run over take the next bar
Priority is blackout, then run over (calm), giant, intense (threat 7+), combat, calm
Stem gains use an equal-power curve times the music volume; fades run on real time in update, with no tweens
